## Preparing an update

A useful short update usually covers what you planned, what you tried, what you learned, and what decision or help you need next. Share slides or notes in the agreed location before the meeting when requested.

## Meeting notes

Record decisions and action items in the lab's approved shared location. Do not include identifiable participant information or confidential material in notes accessible to the entire OneDrive folder.
